Tess H: starting onboarding for Newt's LoRA (newt-prod-lora). quick smoke: EU amounts lose the cents/decimal comma in some responses when context is long. evalpack uploaded: gs://redwood-evals/newt-eur-invoice-quick-v1 :link:
Marco P: can you paste a failing example id?
Tess H: prompt 031: 'Subtotal: €1.234,56' model -> '1234' or '1.234' (drops ',56') intermittently for >2k token contexts.
Zoe: did they supply a tokenizer?
Tess H: yes, finetune used `newt_tok_v1b.json`. our merge applied the LoRA over umbrafux-base tokenizer without rebasing. suspect token-id mismatch around punctuation and currency symbols (i18n).
Marco P: run tokenmap diff: `python3 tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base models/umbra-base/tokenizer.json --other customer/tokenizers/newt_tok_v1b.json`
Marco P: diff snippet:
```
@@
- ",": 17
+ ",": 210
- ".": 56
+ ".": 512
- "€": 402
+ "€": 1101
@@
```
Marco P: comma and euro sign ids moved - that'll change embedding indices for those bytes.
Zoe: agreed. LoRA embedding updates are anchored to token ids; without remap numeric/euro punctuation will reference wrong vectors. Use `tools/rebase_lora_ids.py` to remap LoRA keys to the target tokenizer.
Tess H: plan: (1) fp16 baseline, (2) int4 without remap, (3) int4 with remap, (4) int3 with remap (curiosity). I'll queue on dedicated-gpu-staging.
EvalBot: quick-eval started (job id ej-115500) on dedicated-gpu-9. ETA ~11m.
Marco P: small test added in tests/smoke/i18n_currency.test asserting comma-decimal preserved `\d+\.\d{3},\d{2}` for European format.
EvalBot: job complete. results summary:
- fp16 (no quant): cents preserved 98.9%
- int4 without remap: 65.2%
- int4 with remap: 96.8%
- int3 with remap: 95.0%
Full logs: /mnt/results/ej-115500/summary.json
Zoe: strong signal that remapping fixes the i18n punctuation alignment. int3 slightly worse than int4 after remap here (weird rounding), but both far better than no-remap.
Tess H: going to update the adapter onboarding pipeline: detect tokenizer mismatch, auto-generate mapping, apply remap to LoRA embeddings by default. include `--skip-rebase` opt-out and a note in docs/onboarding_i18n.md.
Marco P: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/adapter-onboard/pull/435 includes remap script, new test, and docs.
Tess H: ops-bot please reserve dedicated-gpu-9 2025-06-20T01:00:00Z-2025-06-20T03:00:00Z for full smokepack run.
ops-bot: reservation confirmed for dedicated-gpu-9 (res-77123) 2025-06-20T01:00:00Z to 2025-06-20T03:00:00Z.
Zoe: also adding a release checklist item: "run tokenmap diff for customer tokenizers and rebase LoRA if differences detected (i18n-focused)" :thumbsup:
